checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Compare FK of the IK-produced target with the demonstrated commanded TCP pose after destination-frame encode/decode, and compare the unchanged gripper scalar. The maximum of position metres, rotation radians and gripper error must be at most 0.005. Quaternion normalization is exact for encoded unit labels; nonunique IK joints are allowed.

contract.cut_relation: Uses all twelve full [680,1160) assigned slices without trimming. The 680:840 retrieval overlap and 900:1160 closing overlap remain action-supervised. The refinement anchors transport convergence, cavity descent/release, retreat, and handle transition to the live destination frame.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is [destination-frame TCP translation xyz in metres, destination-frame canonical unit quaternion wxyz, native gripper scalar]. At training slot k, the frame is target_pose in that slot's pre-action observation. At execution, slots 1..8 are decoded against the fresh current target_pose. The quaternion is normalized (identity only for a degenerate sampled quaternion); the relative pose is left-multiplied by the live destination world pose. panda_kinematics.solve_ik converts the resulting world TCP target to seven absolute joint targets from freshly measured qpos. The gripper scalar is unchanged and the executor applies its binary sign rule.
contract.parameter_semantics: destination_pose_field selects the live observed world pose that defines the Cartesian action frame and is resolved in each causal and execution observation. manipulated_object_pose_field selects the live block world pose used for destination-relative conditioning and release evidence. Positions are metres and quaternions are wxyz.
